definitions.gloss: temple/shrine viewing fee; admission fee for religious sites
definitions.explanation: The fee charged to enter and view a temple, shrine, or other religious/historical site.

examples.japanese: {金閣寺|きんかくじ}の{拝観料|はいかんりょう}は500{円|えん}です。
examples.english: The admission fee for Kinkaku-ji is 500 yen.

examples.japanese: {拝観料|はいかんりょう}を{払|はら}って{境内|けいだい}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: I paid the admission fee and entered the temple grounds.

examples.japanese: この{神社|じんじゃ}は{拝観料|はいかんりょう}{無料|むりょう}だ。

notes:
FORMATION:
{拝観|はいかん} (respectful viewing/worship) + {料|りょう} (fee)
- {拝|はい} expresses humble/respectful attitude
- {観|かん} means viewing

RELATED FEE TYPES:
・{入場料|にゅうじょうりょう} - general admission fee
・{入館料|にゅうかんりょう} - museum admission fee
・{観覧料|かんらんりょう} - viewing fee

COLLOCATIONS:
・{拝観料|はいかんりょう}を{払|はら}う - to pay the viewing fee
・{拝観料|はいかんりょう}{無料|むりょう} - free admission
・{拝観料|はいかんりょう}{込|こ}み - viewing fee included

VERB FORM:
{拝観|はいかん}する - to visit/view (a temple or shrine)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Major temples in Kyoto, Nara, and other tourist areas typically charge {拝観料|はいかんりょう}, while many neighborhood shrines are free to enter.
